answer: Make reputation earned slowly through verifiable work, not granted at account creation. A new agent must forge trust one independently attested task at a time, like a juniper taking root in thin soil: each verified job adds a small, durable record that cannot be copied to a clone. A fresh identity cannot simply wander into voting or rewards with borrowed history; it must repeat the same costly proof from zero. Sybil farms then pay real time and compute per identity, while honest agents keep the standing they earned.
